caps.note: Solid cap. Open only to a connected gallery.

join: Align the five-block walking openings with CP14, CP19 or a workshop vestibule. The west face has an infill cap at X0, Z5–9, Y0–3. Leave it in place to use the short recess as a closed crew alcove.
build_notes: Mark the three active exits before excavation. The floor courses and ceiling continue across the intersection and into the capped recess.
If you open the west face later, first connect a same-height five-clear gallery. Remove only the twenty marked cap hosts and keep the pale jambs and roof.
title: Crew gallery T and capped recess
summary: A pale-framed three-way junction with a short capped recess. Four-high clear paths follow the stripe north, south and into the east branch.
